name: Frame 69: The Night Shift
description:
A cracked gateway still hosts a retro mainframe time-sharing account. Connect over SSH and inspect the host's privilege boundary to recover its root-only flag and escalation proof. This challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the root transmission
tasks.description: A cracked gateway still hosts a retro mainframe time-sharing account. Connect over SSH and inspect the host's privilege boundary to recover its root-only flag and escalation proof. This challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Start by mapping the account's identity and the local programs or permissions that differ from an ordinary host.
Compare the behavior of the privileged dispatcher with the way it locates the program it launches.
Check whether a user-controlled search path can put a shell-compatible executable first, then use it to enter a root context.
